items.Sentence: The Discharger proposes to replace the existing septic tanks at the Ranger Office and the Historic Comfort Station.
From the new septic tanks, wastewater will be conveyed via a 6-inch PVC pipe to a 20,000 gallon dosing tank for flow equalization.
The effluent is then discharged from the dosing tank to one of two pumping basins. Each basin contains two duplex dosing pumps.

The effluent will then be discharged from the pumping basins into a new 3-acre leachfield southwest of the South Entrance Station along an existing service road on a gently sloping hillside that slopes to the south/southwest.
